title: Agenda loading
notes: Loading now shows the agenda structure instead of an empty sheet.

title: Account command rows
notes: The command stays on one line, with its provider above and Copy alongside.

title: New-tab Settings
notes: Settings has a visible label and a clear target.
Agenda metadata uses stronger ink.

title: Compact sidebar in the native window
notes: Tab initials distinguish destinations in the compact rail.

title: Translation settings actions
notes: Save and its status sit inside the settings card, matching Assistant settings.

title: Research citations and failures
notes: Source references are readable links.
Source labels use simple numbering; failures use the common error surface.
The composer has one clear boundary without an outer glow.

title: Saved agenda notice
notes: Saved data is clearly marked before the agenda is read.

title: Settings search
notes: A clear action cue distinguishes each result from a read-only summary.

title: Recognizable shortcut labels
notes: Two-line captions preserve more of each destination name.

title: Assistant without a shareable page
notes: Unavailable sharing controls are removed; the explanation stays visible.

title: Consent and optional automatic translation
notes: Required consent remains a checkbox; optional automatic translation is a switch.

title: Setup progress
notes: The remaining setup has a visible stage count.

title: Update check recovery
notes: The timed-out state keeps the useful retry action and omits unavailable restart.

title: Expanded release explanations
notes: Technical explanations use a reading column below the illustration and introduction.

title: Assistant error details
notes: Error details uses the same disclosure treatment as other assistant panels.

title: Settings load, controlled replay
notes: Navigation keeps its full category layout while feature settings load. The same delayed local module is used in both views.

title: Browser settings groups
notes: Shorter descriptions and four meaningful groups make settings easier to scan.

title: Import guidance
notes: Shorter steps bring the next action closer while retaining privacy guidance.

title: Assistant options
notes: Larger helper text separates the choices from their account details.

title: Release diagram labels
notes: Larger labels improve the narrow illustration.
